description: This file defines a listener class EmployeeSalaryListener that hooks into Doctrine ORM lifecycle events for the EmployeeSalary entity. Its purpose is to encrypt the salary amount before persisting or updating the entity and decrypt it after loading or updating, provided encryption is enabled.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryListener
classes.description: A Doctrine event listener class that handles encryption and decryption of EmployeeSalary amounts during lifecycle events.

methods.name: prePersist
methods.description: Encrypts the salary amount before the entity is persisted to the database if encryption is enabled.

methods.name: preUpdate
methods.description: Encrypts the salary amount before the entity is updated in the database if encryption is enabled and the amount field has changed.

methods.name: postUpdate
methods.description: Decrypts the salary amount after the entity has been updated in the database if encryption is enabled.

methods.name: postLoad
methods.description: Decrypts the salary amount after the entity has been loaded from the database if encryption is enabled.
